messages.text:
Sorry about that. Quick check first, because it changes the fix: what's the unit doing? No power at all, powers on but won't hash, or something else? And what's the order number?

If it's the PSU, we can ship a replacement PSU on its own, no need to send the whole miner back. Anything else goes through RMA with a return label from us. One thing I have to ask either way: has the unit been overclocked or modified? That voids the warranty.
Dead unit - kindly ask JD to reach out to me
Handed to the team · Customer asked for JD on a dead unit; hardware fault plus named-person request.

Done, JD's been pinged and he'll come into this chat. Stay here if you can, and if you step away you'll get the answer by email.

While you wait, two things that'll speed it up: what's the order number, and was the unit ever overclocked or modified? Modified units aren't covered. If it's truly dead on arrival it goes through RMA with a return label from us: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

Good, that keeps it fully covered.

What's the order number? Once I have it I can confirm what shipped and get the RMA started, so JD has everything in front of him when he picks this up.

Fine, JD will have it on his side either way.

So I can try pulling it up here, what name and postcode ····shipping to? If you've got any confirmation email for it, the address it landed at works too.
Just so I don't chase the wrong thing: is Georges the name the unit ships to, or are you asking for Georges from our team to pick this up?
